annotations.title: Edge HTML Sanitizer, Script Stripper & XSS Neutralizer

description: Sanitizes raw HTML by removing malicious script tags, iframes, inline event handlers, and data URIs into safe markup. Use when preparing untrusted third-party web content for rendering in agent dashboards or email clients; for converting clean HTML into markdown, use extract_clean_markdown instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('sanitization_strictness' defaults to 'strip_scripts_and_iframes'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

html_content.description: Untrusted or potentially hazardous HTML string requiring sanitization.

preserve_images.description: Whether to retain safe img elements with http/https sources.

sanitization_strictness.description: Sanitizer filter policy: strip scripts and iframes, allowlist safe formatting, or plaintext strip all.

name: sanitize_html_content

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for sanitize_html_content.

elements_removed.description: List of dangerous tags and attributes removed during processing.

sanitized_html.description: Safe, purified HTML output free of active scripting threats.

xss_vectors_neutralized.description: Count of potential script execution vectors disarmed.
